existing_route_verdict.reason: No accepted conversion from TraversalView to static raster input. Ready builder.scene requires actual parsed parent animation. FrameBuilder/evaluate_frame and both legacy and controlled kernel signatures take ready SceneView. Deferred accepted test installs late animation first and supplies fixture pixels; it does not provide the original timing route. Scalar-sample lib is registration only; no production backend was proved here.

proposed_api.visibility: New names/signatures below are a proposal, not existing declarations. All static-view constructors/fields private to Scene; expose only the request path.
proposed_api.static_view: pub struct StaticPatternView<'a> { /* private borrow of real SceneData tables, SourceOwner, validated Viewport, child identity and request scope; no AnimationView/Option/OwnedAnimation */ }
proposed_api.static_request: pub struct StaticPatternRequest<'a> { pub ticket: PatternTicket, pub child: StaticPatternView<'a>, /* same definition,width,height,tile_width,tile_height,content_transform,error_offset fields as PatternRequest */ }
proposed_api.mint: pub fn request_mapped_static<'a>(&mut self, builder: &'a SceneBuilder, draft: &DraftToken, source: &DecodeSource<'_>, child: SceneId, descriptor: PatternDescriptor, mapping: PatternMapping, shape: ShapeId, channel: PaintChannel, job: &RasterJob, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<StaticPatternRequest<'a>>
proposed_api.event: Add DecodeEvent::NeedStaticPattern(StaticPatternRequest<'a>); keep existing NeedPattern for accepted ready callers. Production decoder emits NeedStaticPattern during provisional traversal.
proposed_api.static_mask_lookup: impl<'a> StaticPatternView<'a> { pub fn mask_content(&self, mask: MaskId) -> Result<StaticPatternView<'a>>; } // only current view's validated mask.content; source/owner/serial/sealed/viewport checks; bounded closure traversal
proposed_api.render_boundary: ControlledFlatKernel::render_flat(&mut self, view: RasterInput<'_>, range: TableRange, options: RenderOptions, job: &mut RasterJob, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<JobRenderOutput>
proposed_api.propagation: Change SceneView input positions along ControlledKernelResources clip/stroke methods, ControlledSampleInput::validate, ControlledSampleKernel and ControlledIndexKernel to RasterInput; provide common read-only table/source/id/viewport getters and typed shape/paint/clip access. Static getter surface has no arbitrary SceneId lookup, mutable data, animation access, ready-view conversion, frame evaluation or freeze. Ready variant delegates existing scene lookups. Static reads original attributes/transforms unchanged; grouped/mask/filter orchestration uses the same input role throughout. Legacy APIs can remain ready-only; no duplicate scratch or fake backend.
proposed_api.completion: Use unchanged PatternTickets::complete_mapped(ticket, &mut builder, &draft, &mut job, result: Result<JobRenderOutput>, control); no raw Vec/Tile handoff.
proposed_api.lifetimes: StaticPatternView borrows builder tables and its Arc source owner, not temporary copied storage. Step event borrows Decoder; save Copy ticket, render with independently owned same job/control, then drop event/view before resume_pattern_production(&mut Decoder,...). Output contains only job-owned handles and generation, never scene references. Borrow prevents parent edits, rollback, source drop, seal/freeze or late animation installation while view is live.

mint_invariants: Run all existing request_mapped_view validations unchanged: draft_index and draft_slot ownership; job.validate_source; Arc::ptr_eq source; same-source pattern token; owner shape SourceMap; computed mapping inverse; child != parent and child.index >= draft.scene_count.

Require builder Traversing with actual AnimationStorage::Pending; child is not root, has no live child draft/request, is sealed by existing validate::scene; parent draft is live and unsealed. For this production route require an active request scope (not an unscoped ready escape).

Require child viewport width/height match descriptor pixels, view origin zero, view dimensions tile_width/tile_height, and explicit none/set aspect as original. Validate reachable mask scenes sealed, same source/owner, positive validated viewport, cycle/work bounds. Never invent a missing viewport.

Mint static capability only after child traversal and all descendant pattern publications succeed. Preserve all table references and typed IDs/serials; do not flatten away masks/groups/filters or rebuild paints from reduced data.

Store existing PatternContinuation mapping,parent,shape,channel,draft nonce,generation,request identity and job identity; existing ticket owner/serial remains authoritative. Revalidate completion after borrow ends; wrong/stale/canceled scopes never attach output.

Charge real reads/render work and buffers to existing control/job; keep overflow/OOM/limit cleanup and partial-output accounting. Do not claim source sharing eliminates child or output allocation costs.

adoption_scope.requirements: Replace constructor early animation with accepted provisional; preserve original root attribute/style/display/transform/viewport order through initialize_root/hidden root. At task exhaustion and root_seen only, parse same-source actual animation and finalize_decode; do not advance to Complete before admission. Child render/publication errors abort before this point.

Use traversal_scene for read-only construction queries currently using ready scene; unwrap only validated optional viewport at required locations. Preserve expansion styles (including canonical pattern-root compute_style with no inherited parent per original), source-backed ranges/transforms, tile viewport, child reset state, control and active-definition accounting. Request static role after commit/seal; build event with borrowed static child without reconstructing ready view. Keep step pending barrier and resume error abort.

Add opaque static role/request/event and shared raster read input as specified; update only actual production raster/resource consumers that require it. Keep existing ready SceneView defaults, AnimationStorage::Pending, require_finalized, FrameBuilder/evaluate_frame signatures, accepted assertions and compile-fail guards intact. Root selects concrete consumer scope; no renderer implementation is asserted by this audit.

nested_and_effect_order: DefinitionWork task stack completes inner pending pattern first; resume attaches inner output before outer child commit/seal and static render. Single outstanding PatternTickets slot suffices because outer ticket is minted only after descendants finish. Preserve active-definition guard until traversal ends; original pops pattern depth before rendering.

Use original cumulative sync_work semantics for references, use/element/transform/paint work, text/image counts, mask/pattern/marker instances and pattern bytes; retain original cycle/depth/instance/byte limits and error categories/offsets. No new delayed render queue.

Media operations execute at their original child traversal point using the existing provider with exact style/source/viewport inputs. Scene/request rollback releases owned child/image/output resources; it cannot undo callbacks. No defer/replay/deduplication or second traversal. Original image callback evidence is pattern.c:280-281 and copied traversal :297 plus image.c:219-239. Rust MediaProvider is an owned-result contract, not permission to alter callback order.

regression_proposal.assert: Exact child diagnostic/category/offset wins; parent animation parser count zero; no next parent task/provider effect; no attached tile; admitted buffers released honestly.

Pattern-root CSS inheritance, transform, tile viewport/aspect, paints/source maps, opacity and nested published tiles remain intact.

regression_proposal.input: Nested acyclic pattern and self/two-node cycle; depth/instance/byte boundary cases; child cancel and control limit at traversal/render/publication.
regression_proposal.assert: Depth-first single pending ticket barrier; original limit/error priority; correct cumulative accounting/cleanup; no later callback/parser invocation on earlier failure.

regression_proposal.input: Wrong/stale ticket; same bytes different Arc; foreign job; altered generation; rollback/replacement child or owner shape; invalid dimensions/stride/output pool.
regression_proposal.assert: Reject under existing identity/typed handle guards, release same-job output where owned, never mutate replacement or publish stale result.
